cards.extra:
echo '== clock'; C=$(gofmt -l -r 'time.Now -> time.Time' users/users.go 2>&1)$(gofmt -l -r 'time.Since -> time.Time' users/users.go 2>&1)$(gofmt -l -r 'time.Until -> time.Time' users/users.go 2>&1); [ -z "$C" ] || { echo "clock: users/users.go reads time.Now, time.Since or time.Until (package users reads no clock: Injected Clock And Ids)"; exit 1; }
echo '== net'; for x in http.DefaultClient http.Get http.Post http.PostForm http.Head http.ListenAndServe http.ListenAndServeTLS; do C=$(gofmt -l -r "$x -> http.NoBody" users/users.go 2>&1); [ -z "$C" ] || { echo "net: users/users.go uses $x (package users opens no listener and runs no HTTP client)"; exit 1; }; done
